A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the horizon is the pass, the ferrous is the fare, the harbor is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. Every epoch charges the same 159 POA again, so 584 masks cost the farm 92856 POA all over again. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
